problem: Website quality needed durable screenshot evidence across responsive edge widths and multiple browser engines, while the visual-quality enhancement initially landed without complete Powerhouse closure evidence.
root_cause: The browser assurance existed, but hard oversized/clipped visual assertions and closure lineage were not terminally coupled.
decision: Keep one canonical website cross-browser assurance and require visual geometry failures to be fixed rather than hidden by threshold widening.
prevention: Chromium sweeps the public sitemap responsively.
Critical routes are screenshot-tested in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
Oversized/clipped media/cards, truncated primary controls and navigation-over-heading are hard failures.
Learning, ledger and documentation are required closure evidence.
